wallet_risk.description: Wallet, address, and counterparty risk data.
wallet_risk.approval_notes: Writers and non-risk roles should not silently buy wallet risk data.

token_risk.description: Token safety, honeypot, tax, proxy, blacklist, and liquidity risk data.
token_risk.approval_notes: Useful for security research; unrelated business roles should require approval.

market_intelligence.description: Market, alpha, trading, or competitive intelligence.
market_intelligence.approval_notes: Accounting roles should be denied by default.

invoice_verification.description: Invoice, receipt, vendor, and payable verification data.
invoice_verification.approval_notes: Appropriate for finance and accounting; unrelated roles should require approval.

payment_execution.description: Payment execution, settlement, transfer, or signing support.
payment_execution.approval_notes: Always approval-gated even when the buyer role matches.

api_security.description: API, OpenAPI, MCP, package, domain, and endpoint security checks.
api_security.approval_notes: A natural fit for operator and research agents.

content_research.description: Public research material used for drafts, documentation, or summaries.
content_research.approval_notes: Should stay limited to public or approved content sources.

production_deploy.description: Deployment, release, production config, or infrastructure mutation tooling.
production_deploy.approval_notes: Approval-gated because it changes production state.

customer_pii.description: Customer personally identifiable information or sensitive user records.
customer_pii.approval_notes: Denied by default in the starter policy.
